entries.name: Account credits
entries.description: Read the committed account credit balance and gross ledger consumption.

endTime.description: Optional UTC epoch milliseconds, exclusive. The window must end no later than the request time.

startTime.description: Optional UTC epoch milliseconds, inclusive. Enter UTC date and time in the tester; the API receives a decimal millisecond string.

code.description: Business result code. Only 0 means success, even when HTTP is 200.

cost.description: Request processing duration in milliseconds, not credits. -1 means non-Web context.

data.description: Committed account credit snapshot on success; null on an error.

cycleCredit.description: Currently valid cycle credits in the committed balance; decimal string.

endTime.description: Actual exclusive UTC epoch-millisecond window end.

grossConsumedCredit.description: Windowed settled account-ledger consumption before refunds; excludes top-ups, admin adjustments, expiry, and debt repayment. Decimal string.

netCredit.description: permanentCredit + cycleCredit − debt; may be negative and does not guarantee a paid call.

observedAt.description: UTC epoch milliseconds when this committed-data read was observed.

permanentCredit.description: Permanent credits in the committed account balance; decimal string.

quota.description: Always null: there is no unified business-call quota.

startTime.description: Actual inclusive UTC epoch-millisecond window start.

msg.description: Optional business message; may be null or omitted on success.

time.description: Server-formatted response time (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss); its zone is not specified by this field.

traceId.description: Optional error trace ID; may be null or omitted on success.

ts.description: Server response timestamp, UTC epoch milliseconds as a decimal string.

entries.name: Account usage
entries.description: Page through recorded business calls across your account API keys.

endTime.description: Optional UTC epoch milliseconds, exclusive. The window must end no later than the request time.

startTime.description: Optional UTC epoch milliseconds, inclusive. Enter UTC date and time in the tester; the API receives a decimal millisecond string.

code.description: Business result code. Only 0 means success, even when HTTP is 200.

cost.description: Request processing duration in milliseconds, not credits. -1 means non-Web context.

data.description: Account API Key business-call usage on success; null on an error.

calls.description: Page of business calls, ordered by record ID descending; free account queries are excluded.

current.description: Current one-based page number, decimal string.

records.description: Call records on this page, including failed, rejected, and uncharged calls.

apiKeyId.description: Calling API Key ID, decimal string, or null for a rejected call without an identified key.

callResult.description: Business call outcome, including rejected and failed requests.

chargeStatus.description: Recorded charge state (for example CHARGED, SKIPPED, FAILED, or NOT_CHARGED), or null.

chargedCredit.description: Credits actually charged for this call, decimal string, or null.

correlationRequestId.description: Server-generated ID shared with tool call diagnostics. Use this ID for diagnostic lookup; null for legacy records.

createTime.description: Call creation time in UTC epoch milliseconds, or null.

id.description: API Key call record ID, decimal string.

latencyMs.description: Call latency in milliseconds, or null.

method.description: Recorded HTTP method, or null.

requestId.description: Original client request ID, or null. This can be reused across calls.

total.description: Total matching call records, decimal string.

endTime.description: Actual exclusive UTC epoch-millisecond window end.

grossChargedCredit.description: Windowed sum of actual chargedCredit for CHARGED business calls before refunds; decimal string.

observedAt.description: UTC epoch milliseconds when this committed-data read was observed.

scope.description: API Key business-call scope, not the full account ledger or JWT activity.

startTime.description: Actual inclusive UTC epoch-millisecond window start.

msg.description: Optional business message; may be null or omitted on success.

time.description: Server-formatted response time (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss); its zone is not specified by this field.

traceId.description: Optional error trace ID; may be null or omitted on success.

ts.description: Server response timestamp, UTC epoch milliseconds as a decimal string.

entries.name: JEV Evaluate API
entries.description: Choose preset mode (useCase + input) or custom mode (state + questions); never mix the two. Custom mode supports noul, choice, and score, with independent answers in result.answers. Model, identity, upstream URL, and execution thresholds remain server-owned. Supplied context and questions are sent to TypeSafe. Decisions are advisory; keyword presets judge only supplied business, SERP, candidate, and product-fact evidence. Requires an active Nexscope subscription. Each route or evaluate call deducts 1 Nexscope credit; any selected data API retains its existing billing. Route and evaluate share limits of 20 requests per user per minute, 200 requests globally per minute, and 5,000 requests globally per rolling day; each route or evaluate call counts as one request. Quota admission is sequential: per-user minute, global minute, then global rolling day; an earlier admitted counter remains incremented if a later check rejects the request.

requestSchema.description: Choose exactly one request mode: useCase + input, or state + questions. Maximum serialized request: 16,000 UTF-8 bytes. Model, upstream URL, identity, and execution thresholds are server-owned and cannot be supplied. All text must be non-blank.

input.description: Checks credential_exposure, harmful_instruction, deceptive_claim, instruction_override, and severity. The fixed server policy maps the checks to pass, review, or block.
input.title: response_guardrails input

input.description: Checks trademark, copyright, patent, other IP, and insufficient-context signals plus risk type and severity. The result always requires human review and is not legal clearance.

text.description: Authorized product or description text for advisory IP-risk triage.

input.title: ip_risk_triage input

input.description: Requires query and at least one supplied title, metaDescription, or contentExcerpt. Scores relevance only; it does not predict rankings, traffic, search volume, or intent data.
input.title: seo_relevance input

input.description: Assesses the claim only against sourceText. If supplied quote is absent after whitespace normalization, the server returns deterministic quote_not_found without a model call.

quote.description: Optional quote that must occur in sourceText after whitespace normalization.

input.title: evidence_check input

input.description: Fields depend on the selected preset; see the mode schemas below.

criteria.description: Optional definitions of yes and no.

instructions.description: One specific question about state. Required by Nexscope.

criteria.description: Option IDs mapped to descriptions; null uses the option ID as its meaning.

instructions.description: One specific question about state. Required by Nexscope.

criteria.description: Ordered levels starting at 0. The returned score is a probability-weighted average.

instructions.description: One specific question about state. Required by Nexscope.

questions.description: Required in custom mode. 1–32 independent questions, keyed by caller-defined IDs.

state.description: Required in custom mode. Non-empty context shared by every question; supplied data is sent to TypeSafe.

responseSchema.description: Nexscope response envelope for preset or custom evaluation. Decisions are advisory and never trigger another API or publishing action.

code.description: Zero on success; non-zero for validation, access, quota, or availability errors.

data.description: Fixed server policies cover response safety, IP triage, SEO relevance, evidence checks, business-keyword relevance, keyword same-page clustering, and Amazon product-keyword fit. Keyword presets return bounded rows keyed only by caller-supplied IDs.

checks.description: Empty in custom mode; answers are in result.answers. Fixed Noul, Score, or Choice checks for the preset: response risks and severity; IP signals, risk_type, severity, and insufficient_context; supplied SEO dimensions; or evidence verdict. Deterministic quote_not_found returns an empty object.

decision.description: Presets return pass/review/block. Custom mode returns evaluated, which means answers are available, not that an action is approved.

model.description: Resolved model version, or null for deterministic quote_not_found.

policyVersion.description: jev-evaluation-v1 for original presets; jev-keyword-tools-v1 for keyword presets; jev-custom-v1 for custom questions.

reasonCodes.description: Fixed reason codes without submitted text.

result.description: Preset-specific bounded result. Keyword presets return result.rows with caller-supplied IDs, fixed labels, confidence, and fixed reason or evidence references.

answers.description: Custom mode only. Answers keyed by question ID: noul returns {type, noul}; choice returns {type, choice, confidence, probabilities}; score returns {type, score, confidence, probabilities, legend}. No automatic policy or token usage is returned.
